WildSpark 2.2.12 fixes gathering skill display on minimap node hover tooltips. Herbalism and Mining nodes show their name and required skill level, colored by the player's current skill. A fallback hook covers Forever builds where minimap tooltip-data callbacks are unavailable.

This release retains the 75 rare-spawn reference timer records, labeled unverified for WoW Forever, with local and peer-shared observations taking priority.
